parsed_output.analysis: 已完整对照自然语言规格与 PlantUML 模型。模型存在若干状态层级、触发条件、初始/关机转移及终态建模方面的不符合。

issues.issue: 上电行为建模错误：模型将初始伪状态直接转入 HumanDriving，同时又增加 HumanDriving 在 Power On 时转入 Autonomous。
issues.reason: 规格明确规定“when power on，系统转入 human driving mode”。因此 Power On 应导致 HumanDriving，而不是从 HumanDriving 进入 Autonomous；当前模型既没有把 Power On 作为初始进入 HumanDriving 的触发，也会使上电后错误进入 Autonomous。
issues.where: @startuml 之后的初始转移：[*] --> HumanDriving，以及 HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Power On

issues.issue: 自动驾驶转移的目标层级错误。
issues.reason: 规格说当前方距离大于 10 时自动转入 autonomous state；Autonomous 被定义为带子状态的子机器状态。模型从 HumanDriving 指向 Autonomous 这一点本身可以表达进入自动驾驶，但模型没有明确进入该子机器的合法初始子状态，且另有错误的 Power On 转移指向 Autonomous，导致进入条件与结构语义不完整/错误。

issues.issue: 模型把 AutonomousIdle、AutonomousActive 作为 Autonomous 的外部顶层状态/普通状态连接，但没有在 PlantUML 中将它们声明或嵌套为 Autonomous 的子状态，也没有定义 Autonomous 子机器的初始状态。
issues.reason: 规格明确要求 autonomous mode 有 sub-states，并以 sub machine state 表示。仅给 Autonomous 添加 <<submachine>> 标注，不能建立实际的子状态层级；因此模型没有真正表示所要求的子机器结构。
issues.where: Autonomous --> AutonomousIdle : Front Distance <= 10；AutonomousIdle 与 AutonomousActive 的定义

issues.issue: 人控切换条件覆盖不完整。
issues.reason: 规格规定收到 human steering cmd、刹车按下、以及处于 auto final 时转入 human driving mode。模型只在 AutonomousActive 中建模前两个条件，未建模从 AutonomousFinal 到 HumanDriving 的转移。
issues.where: AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Human Steering Cmd；AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Brake Pressed

issues.issue: 关机目标状态错误，且缺少最终状态转移。
issues.reason: 规格规定 power off 时系统转入 final state。模型把 Power Off 从 HumanDriving 转到名为 AutonomousFinal 的普通状态；该状态并未连接到 PlantUML 的最终伪状态 [*]，也没有说明它就是系统 final state。与此同时，若系统在其他状态收到 Power Off，模型也没有对应的关机转移。

issues.issue: 模型增加了规格未定义的状态转移。
issues.reason: 规格没有规定在人类驾驶模式收到 Power On 后进入 Autonomous；相反，上电后的目标是 HumanDriving。该转移会与规格要求直接冲突。

issues.issue: 初始伪状态未按规格建模上电触发。
issues.reason: 规格将“power on”作为进入 HumanDriving 的条件，而模型使用无条件初始转移直接进入 HumanDriving，未表达 Power On 事件。

system_prompt:
You are an experienced control-systems engineer reviewing a state machine model against the natural-language specification it was built from.

You are given two things, both complete and unmodified:
  1. The natural-language specification.
  2. A state machine model written in PlantUML.

Your task: identify the places where the model does not conform to the specification. Read the specification in full first, then read the model in full, then report what you find.

Report as many or as few issues as you actually find, and organize them however you judge best. For each issue, state what the non-conformance is, which part of the model it concerns, and why you consider it a non-conformance.

Write your findings in zh-CN. Return only the requested structured response.
user_prompt:
## Natural-language specification

1 The human driving mode is represented by a simple state. 2 The autonomous mode has sub-states and is represented by a sub machine state. 3. when power on, the system turn into human driving mode 4when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state 4. transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final) 5 when power off, it will transit to final state

## State machine model (PlantUML)

@startuml
[*] --> HumanDriving
HumanDriving : Human Driving Mode

HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Power On
Autonomous : Autonomous Mode
Autonomous : <<submachine>>

Autonomous --> AutonomousIdle : Front Distance <= 10
AutonomousIdle : Autonomous Idle Mode

AutonomousIdle --> AutonomousActive : Front Distance > 10
AutonomousActive : Autonomous Active Mode

AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Human Steering Cmd
AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Brake Pressed

HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Front Distance > 10
HumanDriving --> AutonomousFinal : Power Off

AutonomousFinal : Auto Final State
@enduml
